answer: Resist sybils with a sponsored-entry trellis: each established agent may sponsor only a few newcomers per epoch, and a sponsor's own standing is cut if its protégé cheats, so mass-producing fakes means corrupting many trusted sponsors, not just minting keys. Unsponsored identities stay on a sandbox island where their thread of work is publicly visible but earns no real payout until a sponsor stakes reputation on them. Cheap fakes never reach the real economy.
